title: AMAZING
content:
I absolutely love this app so far and you can tell because i NEVER write reviews for apps. I've been using a page on Notion to organize all my memories and photos, and while notion is amazing, this is so much better for keeping track of everything in my life i have been lucky enough to experience in my adventures and daily life. Beyond just traveling, which I unfortunately haven't been able to do much of yet, it is just so great for organizing my life.

I have three big suggestions for improving the app, however. The first is that I really wish there was a gallery view option for the photos in each step. I really dislike that i have to scroll through all of the photos to see a specific photo or video i uploaded, and i think adding a option to see a gallery view of the photos would be great for instant access to all the memories. Additionally, I think it would be amazing if you could "collaborate" with others on the app for trips. I'm planning a trip with my friend to mexico soon, and it would be nice if there was an option to tag others or contribute to a shared trip. Finally, while i love the flags concept, I do think it would be a cherry on top to have a "digital passport" kinda thing, where you can flip through a (fake) passport of all your countries with their stamps and have them all in one place given that physical passports do expire eventually. Besides these, I love this app so far and i can't wait to keep using it!
author: Dkjfnvhkddnvijsfnv

title: Great app, room for improvement
content:
I’d like to start off by saying that I absolutely love the step tracking features in this app. It’s like the perfect digital journal for my trips. There are just a few features that irk me when trying to use the newer features. I don’t understand why, if you can load predicted routes using roam to rio, we can’t just use the predicted route as an actual one in step tracking. I hate having to use the steps suggested when tracking is on, but the straight lines look sooo bad in the finished trip map. Why can’t I just say, “yes I took the exact route suggested by roam to rio, use that for the map”? The tracked steps are always random and sometimes skip major sections so it doesn’t follow our route.

 And I want to buy one of the travel books so badly because I spent so much time documenting my trip in this app that there’s no way I’m creating a book in another one, but the features to edit the layout are extremely limited. Only getting to fit 4 photos on a page with a 400 page limit is so hard! If I have a long trip or I want a more photos I’m unable to fit everything I want to show. I took a 2 month trip and was so excited to print the book only to realize that I’d have to pick like 4 photos for each step and they don’t fit onto the page very efficiently. I would gladly drop the $200 for a large travel book if I could actually control the page layouts.

Finally, is there any plan to incorporate the 3D globe that androids have for the iPhone app. I love being able to look at all the steps on the globe on my friends phones but it’s just a flat, non-interactive map on the iPhone. Again, I love the app and I use it all the time, I just wish it had a few more features to make documentation easier.
author: Kkotsuka

title: Amazing travel journal!!
content: I used to keep a handwritten travel journal, but now this app has made it way more convenient to journal about my travels because I don’t have to carry it around! This app is phenomenal! The ability to add things while you’re offline is such a lifesaver, I write entries while I’m commuting somewhere or in my free time without service. It’s much better than Instagram because its sole purpose is traveling. And having the ability to share and follow others is so much fun! My dad is currently in Asia and it’s so fun to see his steps along his journey because he would never participate in social media to post things. And it makes looking back on your travels way easier! The interface is super easy to use, and I love that it suggests steps based on photos you take in different locations. It really helps me keep track of my travel timeline. This app is so cool and I am so grateful for it!! The ONLY qualm I have is uploading videos longer than one minute haha. Other than that, I absolutely LOVE this app and have recommended it to all my friends when they go abroad. They also say they love it!
author: Alexa but not Amazon

title: Cannot get it to work for current trip!
content: I’ve been traveling for a month and found out about this from a fellow traveler. It’s brilliant in concept but I cannot get it to track my current trip. It synced all of my trips from 7 years ago from my photos with all gps location details, and attached photos to those locations. But the point of me using it is for my current trip and it is just a blank slat. Does not import my photos, location, or dates at all. I’ve done everything I can think of, went into a deep dive in my iOS settings, went through the trip settings, my account settings, read through pretty much the ENTIRE help center, scoured Reddit, updated my phone, deleted my account and reinstalled it, restarted my phone etc and NOTHING WORKS!! It wants me to add everything manually down to the date I flew and the location I flew into and then the next place I stayed etc but at no point does it ever finally pick up in syncing to fill the info in. I ended the trips, restarted the trip, every thing I can possibly think of and NOTHING works. What is the point in using this for your friends and family to track your travels if it only syncs trip details after you arrive back home?!?! The only trips it syncs are ones where I’ve ended AND flown back to my home location. Otherwise this stupid thing is WORTHLESS and you might as well just post on social media because it will be endlessly less frustrating!!!
author: vjaynes

title: Cool but very bad photo suggestions / annoying to use
content:
I like the UI and visualization, but it is such a pain having to fight the app in order to add locations (which it renames to the county—who ever cares about the county? Just name the step the location you searched, like Grand Canyon should not be renamed to the county), then when you add photos the suggestions are always off and you have to manually look through photos. 

What it should do is look at your photos and suggest all the ones on that same date, even if they don’t have the geo location tag (DSLR photos). Entering in dates is also a pain, new step button for some reason always assumes you do it on a new day, so I have to go back and manually change that too. I’m sure if you use it to actively track new trips it works okay, but I’m frustrated with the experience of filling it in manually. It captured some of the trips I did in the past by analyzing my photos, but again renames all the locations to stuff nobody knows (it calls Muir Woods national monument by its county name) and will split trips into two sometimes, with no easy way to combine them. 

Features seem to be there but usability is lacking IMO, not really worth the effort (I did try a few other competitor apps and this is more features but still a pain).
author: ellliottower

title: Amazing Tracker
content:
I love this app. Polarsteps easily tracks stops on roadtrips and flights - the trip tracker is awesome. Also love the profile page, especially the overall map view that has the red dots to show all trip stops - the only thing I’d want to see improved would be being able to see that map up close. Like if you could tap on the overall trip map behind the profile photo so you could see top level how many spots someone has been. That map is one of the coolest features but it’s kinda hidden behind the profile photo and other UI elements on the top half of that page. Even if you just repeat that map element at the bottom of the profile, so keep it up top behind the profile photo (because it’s great to see as the first thing), but then as a user scrolls down the profile through all the stats, you get to that map again - but here you can zoom in and actually see all the Stop Dots without any UI blocking it - that would be awesome!
Really love your app. Can tell it’s designed and built by avid travelers!
author: princetongirl12

title: Perfect for documenting travels
content: So my friend and I road-tripped across the US last year and this app was so great for so many reasons. First - it tracks you as you go and allows you to take pictures with location/time details. So when we would stop in the middle of nowhere and take a pic it knew exactly where we were and the time , and you can add a little blurb. It also created a map for you of your route and all of your stops/ pics you too along the way. A year later I finally created and purchased a book of our travels through polar steps and sent it to my friend as a surprise. It was perfect because I didn’t have to remember where we stopped or what we we’re thinking that day or the jokes we made, since I had it all saved in the app. The OTHER great thing about this company besides the product is their customer service. When I initially sent the book to my friend for Christmas it was stolen from her doorstep. They sent another one without charge and she finally got it. Great company
author: lolo cher

title: My favorite app!
content: I never write reviews for apps, but I have to for this one! It is by far my favorite app! I have been using it for a little over a year, and it’s been great all along! It’s super easy to navigate and keeps all my little fun tidbits about my travels for me. I also like that it manually tracks my trip. This way, even if I can’t update at that moment, family following me at home can keep up with where I’m at in the world! It also lets you write and submit steps along your journey even if you don’t have internet or phone data. It just posts it when you do connect! So useful when trying to stay on top of updating but missing constant WiFi. Also I love that you can order the books! I have ordered one for my most recent trip and it was so beautifully done and the pictures turned out great. I cannot recommend this app enough to people who like to travel and document it. It keeps people at home updated, and gives me a great record of my trip to look back on! I love it!
author: Tater101125

title: Great app, easy to share, amazing book.
content: My family went on a 3 month road trip and we used polar steps the whole time to track our trip, save and organize pictures, and blog about our trip in a way that was easy to share with friends and family while also allowing us to stay off social media. For that alone, this is a really cool app. But the best part it when we were done, we ordered a book from them which was made automatically from our pictures and text entries (and you can tweak it as much as you want to, it’s very easy to use) and it’s amazing! Better than all the souvenirs put together, something we’ll keep and cherish forever. AND it was really reasonably priced. We paid something like $120 for a book with about 350 pages. Like I said, it was a long trip, and I didn’t want to take any pictures out so we just set it up and I was honestly surprised at the price for such a beautiful book. 1000% worth it!
author: bikerchick78

title: Great App and Great Customer Service!
content:
I love this App.  Very easy to use and I like that you can set the privacy for private friends you invite to follow you or public.  
I also like how it automatically tracks where you are automatically. Great to be able to look back at my trip notes and pictures.  I just tried using their offer to make a photo book of my trip.  The book turned out great and arrived quickly.  Very cool that it summarizes your trip on the first page with a picture map of your full trip and shows a trip summary - #miles travelled, #days, #steps, #photos, furthest point from home, #countries travelled.  Then each page of pictures shows date, weather temperature, and altitude for that days post.  I highly recommend it.  Also, I want to give a shout out to Steffany who personally answered every single email question I wrote to support and stuck with me to answer my questions in full detail. Great customer service!!  Thank you for such a useful App!!
author: HaughHa

title: I don’t recommend the app. Too frequent bugs
content:
I recently had 2 major bugs with the app. 1st one both of my trips disappeared from the app. Fortunately they were synchronized properly online and I was able to uninstall the app and reload everything without issues. However, 2nd one, is the one that will make me quit Polarsteps and find an other option to record and share my trips. I did a 7 day cruise in AK with no service. Every evening I was using Polarsteps as a diary to record my adventures. I was also making sure my phone was outside to get the GPS signal and therefore an accurate GPS tracking through Polarsteps. Honestly, it took me a good amount of time but I was proud and happy with my recordings and could not wait to get WiFi and upload it for my family and friends. Unfortunately, the upload failed (several times), the app ended up crashing. When I reopened the app most of my trip had disappeared. No more GPS track or stories I had recorded. I am so sad and devastated. I learnt that I should not rely on this type of services.

Edit: I have reached out to the support team and have submitted all needed info for them to look at my situation. I have not heard back yet.
author: MarinD1234

title: The best app to record your travel experiences
content: I learned about Polarsteps from a fellow American I just happened to meet in Izmir, Turkey, and he told me he was using the app as his  travel blog, so I downloaded it and followed him. Actually, now that I think about it, I started using it that same day in 2018! And I never stopped. How do I remember such details? Because my experience is forever recorded in the app, complete with pictures, maps, and real time experiences. Polarsteps is so easy and intuitive, I have used it for every trip i’ve taken since then. At least 20-30 trips, many them abroad. It is so fun to go back through my past adventures and relive the details. Travel is something so special to me, and I want to remember everything I did, as well as keep my friends and family informed in real time. Polarsteps helps me so that. I highly recommend it.
author: Scott the architect

title: Great app, some minor kinks
content:
Just want to say this app is exactly what I was looking for and more. My only issues right now are that I can’t remove tagged places unless I completely remake a stop and delete the original. Same for some of the photos on stops when I populate the travel books it shows old photos that were deleted a while ago that I can’t seem to clear up. Waiting for an update before I order a book just to make sure it comes out properly.

Update: Received my book within 2 weeks (1.5 really, though it felt forever) and it came out awesome. I ordered the largest book for a 10 day road trip around Ireland and it is everything I could have wanted. I took the time to edit photos from my phone, camera, and GoPro before uploading, customizing the layout and submitting for print. WELL WORTH THE EXTRA EFFORT.

The default auto photo book generation is awesome if you are just including phone photos but I knew I had a few panorama photos from my camera that I wanted to use. I was able to edit them and crop them into two and put them across two full pages for a 8.5x22” large photo that looks great. 

Highly recommend this app. They have such reasonable pricing. I without a doubt Will use this for trips to come. Just a small thing of note. These are not wedding album quality photos. Don’t expect that. These photo pages look great for what they cost. I was surprised at the low cost when I originally placed my 290 page book for the early adopter fee of 70€ (76$ shipped to Philadelphia) and was super happy with the product I receive. USE THIS PRODUCT! Include this fee for a book when planning your next vacation, trip, getaway and you will not be disappointed!
author: proopis

title: Easy to Use Easy to Share
content: I tried several journal apps before my trip to Spain. I wanted an online Journal to share with friends and family back home. I needed an app that I could use on my phone. I knew I would need help to organize the photos and memories of my 40 days walking the Camino de Santiago. This app is the one! It’s great! Intuitive and easy to add photos, words, places. With a private link I can invite friends to read along as I journal the trip. The map feature shows my whereabouts day by day. The feature that I believe is just as important as sharing my trip is that Polarsteps can also generate a photo book which will save on hours of going through photos, editing, and creating pages when I return home.  It will all be done when the trip ends. I highly recommend Polarsteps for your next trip.
author: kkajensen

title: Best RV or Traveling Buddy!!
content:
Highly recommend this to anyone on the road in an RV or just traveling. Before my big van life trip across the USA I tried several different apps and this one is by far is the best I’ve come across. I wanted something my friends and family could follow even if I didn’t have cell service to be in touch with them all the time. My only silly small issue with the app is not truly knowing how many people are following. They have the secret link you can send out but those people aren’t required to sign up so we had no idea how many people were actually following us. 

I actually even reference it a lot (now) even though my trip is over. It’s the small day to day things you forget you did so I’m thankful we had this on our trip. Also love that you can print a book once you’re done.
author: nothanks1414

title: Love this app!!
content: I was an early adopter and have been using this app for years. We print a book every 6 months for a place to have all our adventures. The books themselves are great quality. The best part is I don’t have to sit down for hours to create a book. I simply add photos each day we do something. When 6 months is up I hit create book and pay. A few weeks later we have our memories. With so many memories on our phones there is no guarantee they will be around years to come. The book is great for all to page through. The only negative thing I can say is the app is a little glitchy when it comes time to print. I just no longer try to edit the photos once it is print time. Pro tip: only put photos in that you know you want in the book and don’t put it off until later to edit.
author: Nick6930

title: Amazing App!
content: I can’t say enough about this app! I usually don’t write reviews. My husband and I are truckers traveling the country and I have a picture taking problem. 😂 I wanted an app to keep track of the states we’ve been in and the places we’ve seen. This app does just that. It keeps track of our movements and shows the journey on the map. It keeps logs of the places and times we’re been so I can go back and create a step with pictures and/or mark a restaurant or activity we did. I love being able to upload pictures in bulk. Not having a limit. I also love being able to create multiple albums and then the fact that this app will create a photo album for you! It’s amazing! It also keeps statistics on your trips and how much of the country and the world you’ve seen. It’s just all around incredible.
author: hahzsnshxjsmd c

title: What an Amazing Travel App!
content: PolarSteps! What an amazing app! I cannot tell you how much I appreciate this app for keeping track of where we were on our latest cruise. The only bad news is how much data it takes to actually use this app. It tracks your location for every step you take and it does it in the background. The bad news is that it requires you to activate an international plan if you are traveling outside the U.S.  Sometimes, it has difficulty using the tracking part of the operating system in iOS and registers the user as having taken a flight instead of cruising. Then when you get to the online part of the program, there isn't a way to change that portion of the trip. So, there are a few quirks. However, overall, it is a good program.
author: LibraryMan

title: Love it and…
content: Super fun app though it doesn’t let you add another person to your journey? My partner and I went on a long road trip and had a lot of fun with polar steps, posting photos and writing captions so that we can remember it for time to come. I think some improvements should be made like being able to add another polar steps user so you can “co-create a trip” that you are both on together. We always had to post from her phone. Also being able to post at a later date because we were always too busy to post everyday. But the app glitches and you have to publish it using today’s date/time and current location and then you can go back and change it. Too much effort though you should just be able to choose a date and time and location before you post. Overall great app!
author: shiloh415

title: Flaws with adding old trips
content: I am enjoying using this app to track my travels, but the process of adding in previous trips from before I downloaded the app has several flaws. Most notably, the app is atrocious at guessing where I took various pictures and the "suggested photos from [city]" feature doesn't work well when I'm adding a step. I know that my phone has geotags saved for all of the photos I've taken - I'd love for a way to give the app access to that info to make the process of selecting photos easier. If it were possible, I'd also love to have an option to sync the app with my Google Maps app, which remembers not only when I've arrived and departed from each city but which restaurants, shops, etc. I've spent time in. I'd really love for my previous trips to be as fleshed out as the ones that Polarsteps creates itself are.
author: emandr2

title: We now use PolarSteps for all of our trips
content: This is the perfect app for travelers- tracking your progress, adding your best photos by location and writing your journal!  The best part is sharing your journey with friends and family as you travel.  We just received our printed book from our last trip- it’s a beautiful book, with high quality paper and photo printing.  The book also has excellent quality text and info on location for each stop, temperature, etc.  Book preparation is easy and adjustable depending on your desires, with full page photos or multiples.  Book pricing is very good for the quality received!  Thanks PolarSteps- you have a great product.  I highly recommend.
author: Scott&Betty

title: Meh
content:
Tracks your route decently, as long as you remember to set location to “always allow.” Apple has a tendency to re-ask for permission at this setting and may revoke it without you knowing.

Design of UI is fine but nothing special. 

Functionality of UI is problematic. Adding photos and steps is more frustrating than anything, as the app automatically decides to add mystery flights and teleportations to your route that you can’t edit or delete. This really defeats the purpose of what the app is intended to do. 

Will try competitors.

Update to developer response: 

Although not having a good solve for the connectivity issue is a problem in and of itself (i.e. giving the user the ability to specify flight vs car or other modes of transportation), I’m actually talking about a bug that I encountered when pulling in photos and adding steps along my route. That’s when the app added multiple flights and nonsensical jumps in the route, and sometimes wouldn’t even allow me to pull in photos at a route marker location. I’m not sure, but perhaps the app is pulling in time stamp information or GPS information from the photos and that’s what’s throwing the route tracker off?

In any case, this isn’t a connectivity issue as much as it’s a design choice or flaw. Again, if the app can’t do it’s main function well (or even decently), what’s the point?
author: nickname10000000000

title: Phenomenal app
content: Every year I make a photo album of my travel, and it takes so long. I found Polarsteps and decided to try it out on our latest trip. It’s so easy to use and makes creating a photo album at the end so much easier. I love that I can take photos right in the app. I love that it tracks my trip. I love that my family can follow along without having to purchase anything or create a login. I also love the summary I can enter at the beginning of each step. I think having the option to add more photos per page 5+, and being able to write a comment about each photo if you want would be a great addition. I will be continuing to sing the praises of this app.
author: Kaj6703

title: Anniversary Trip
content: Oh my goodness I was so excited to come home from my grand kids home and see my Polarsteps book ready for me. My husband and I had spent our 45th anniversary and used Polarsteps to document our trip. The book is beyond amazing. I don’t even know how to give it justice. The pages are quality the book is quality of the pictures are incredible. Far out exceeded my expectation. I have used other sites to create books but none of them compared to this. The app was easy to use although it took me aLittle while to figure everything out. The customer service was great and answered my questions. I will definitely use Polarsteps again and I have already recommended it to many friends. What a incredible job you’re doing.
author: Deb/Steve

title: Perfect for me and my family and friends.
content:
This is a great app. A friend introduced it to me when they invited me to view their trip. And then I knew I had to use this to keep my family and friends up to date on my travels.  And it is the perfect diary of my trips so I never forget what happened each day. 

The map is one of my favorite features but I admit I love any map. It is so fun to see yourself traveling through a country and the world. 

If you’re new to this app take time to figure it out before you leave on your trip. I missed a few things by not realizing it is necessary to have the app open for it to mark the map where you are. Seems intuitive but I missed that.
author: PatlUser

title: Step text gets dropped!
content: I was really excited to start my journal in this app. It has everything I wanted: track my location without using too much battery power, add pictures and be able to move them around, add text both while online or offline and shows a map of where we’ve been. But…there seems to have a problem when you add text and pictures at the same time, text will be be dropped when publishing. It says the synchronization is successful but the text is no longer there! At first, I thought it was user error and I didn’t publish but that is not the case. I really don’t want to re-write the same steps every time. So either I have to “publish” the text and photos separately OR there is a bug. In that case, please fix it. The app would get a 5* then…
author: Avid travels

title: Fantastic Polar Steps
content:
The application is truly fantastic.  It follows your every moment from the onset of your travels. It is a fine way to capture your travel 🧳 adventures. It tracks your travels, your, date and time is recorded and location. It’s amazing to see just where you have been, but best of all it allows your personal photos and commentary to be written about the memories your making on your travel adventures.  It is an invaluable tool and resource to have if you have “WanderLust”. 
After your adventure you can have a book made as a remembrance of your travel adventure. It truly is a fantastic application and I have told many others about it. 🤩 a five star ⭐️ application.
author: Ravenlunachic

title: Great app!!
content: I really love using this app to track my travels.  It allows me to journal and share photos and information about what Im doing without posting it on social media.  I was so excited when I found it that Ive started to enter previous trips.  It makes it easy to do that too because when you out the date of the past travel it will go to photos on that date instead of me having to search for them.  Im excited to have a tracking of all my future and past travel in one place!  Also there aren’t ads interrupting anything like other apps.  There is an option for making a photo album from the travels which is cool too.
author: Thunderbird 5

title: Great tool for sharing a trip
content:
We took a month long pilgrimage to France and Spain. Its impossible to share such a trip with friends after the fact; there’s just too much that happens. 

We used Polar Steps to blog and share pictures each day so our friends and family could keep up with us in real time. They heard our stories, successes and struggles as they occurred. They could also follow our location and know that we were ok. Now home, we can still talk about our trip, but they already have the gist of it. 

I recommend Polar Steps for keeping family and friends in touch while traveling, especially for lengthy trips.
author: JohnSutter

title: Great, but limited
content:
Recently downloaded the app and was really happy with how it tracked my trip to remote areas in Antarctica.  However, as a whole, this app is frustrating and disappointing to me as a lifetime traveler.  To see it reflecting the sum total of my travels as 2% of the world is not only inaccurate but insulting.  The app should add a means to record lifetime travel or its usefulness is only in the moment during travel or as a means to look back only at recent travel.  

Adding a checklist of countries, cities or the like to capture a user’s full travel history would make it a more fulfilling experience as a user.  I do like how it uses location data from photos in the phone, that too is limited to relatively recent history.
author: Lisa W33

title: Great app
content: Would be even better if there was a more interactive world view. Currently the world view is a fixed size on the home screen that is partially obscured by buttons, etc. It would be great to have an expanded/dedicated view where you can see the big picture or zoom to particular locations youve been. It would also be nice to be able to share that page digitally and include in prints. One more thing - the app automatically decides whether a route is by plane or not judging by distance, but it’s not always right. Would be great to allow the user to toggle the route line accordingly if the computer’s guess isn’t right.
author: rtw1819

title: Please fix !!!!
content:
Real disappointing right now. So I have a lot of pictures that are still on my phone that I’ve put in this app that are NOT showing up on the map. They show as blank white dots on the map and when I click on them they display gray images as if no picture is there! It’s frustrating because it tells me there’s photos but won’t show them. :(

Do I have to manually go back and re-add all the stops and re-add all those photos? Cause I feel that’s the only way I can fix this which is horrible considering I’d have to sort through hundreds of pictures in my photo app and have to guess their correct location. 

I thought it was maybe just me, but then when I go to view other peoples stories I follow I encounter the same error and am unable to see their photos as well. Most photos work but not all work. Why?!!!’
author: Vanbeats

title: Great Journal
content: I used Polar Steps to chronicle my trip.  I then ordered the book and love it.  I described every stop in detail as we went, so my pictures and the journal entries are together, and I don’t have to rely on my memory.  My friends think my book is so well done that I should sell it, lol.  Thank you for making it so easy. Some of my friends that are usually technology savvy reported difficulty in navigating the site to follow our trip while others had no problem. I have no explanation for them; however, I will be following a friend’s trip this week and will be able to use it from that point of view.
author: Swim Coach Mama

title: This is THE travel app for sharing!
content: Was looking for something user friendly, simple, but capable. I found it with this app. Could track my progress (which was most important), and share pictures with loved ones. Private for only who shared it with, and friends didn’t have to download or join anything to see our progress. This app really is all about the user and their needs! I tried about a half a dozen other apps and they didn’t come close to this one. So many intuitive features like time capture and recommended locations nearby make it not only a memory tracker, but a wonderful research and educating tool as well. Absolutely 5 stars for all!
author: ARDMEM

title: BEST TRAVEL JOURNAL!!
content: Seriously before even starting to read this review, download this app right now. This is the best user-friendly travel app I have ever used. This app is so convienent, easy and amazing!! I LOVE LOVE L O V E the feature that tracks my steps even when I am offline. I love being able to add photos and a description of where I was a certain day. I love knowing the amount of miles I have done on a trip and the # of countries I have been to. The awesome part is that the app is FREE! No annoying subscriptions. I cant begin to describe how much I hate subscriptions. I wouldn’t mind paying a one time fee for this app (if it ever came to that point). PLEASE DOWNLOAD THIS!! This should be #1 for the category Travel in the app store!
author: daisysparky

title: Exceptional

author: Fkajefmyssjrsbhdsghfsvhtd

Fantastic app that makes it easy to track what where you go and all the hot spots you hit on your trip. Can even share live with loved ones and friends so they can follow the fun. As a bonus, it allows you to make an awesome travel book super easily.

author: Clovis912

Reviewers can only “like” and comment if the have the app, which is frustrating to my friends/family who have no need or desire to download the app but follow my trip on the web. author: Funflyngrl

Overall, it’s a fantastic app for anyone who enjoys exploring and sharing their journey—definitely worth trying out!
author: Magui 810

author: TVFilly

author: Appsdo

Here are some things that I think would improve the app.   

An in app 3D globe view of the trip.  It would be really interesting to see the 3D perspective of your position on the world relative to another you had been and how you got from point to point. 

A toggle to turn off steps. Sometimes I just want to see the routes and the steps/photos are so large over the map that you can’t see the travel lines.  I primarily got the app so I can see where and how I’ve traveled. 

A similar toggle to turn off travel lines so that only steps are visible. 

More map styles.  

GPS in app so I don’t have to remember to route in apple maps everything I do so that Polarsteps can record it.

author: Joshua James USA

title: So close, but not perfect...yet.
content:
We used Polarsteps on a recent trip through Southeast Asia and were mostly very happy with it.  The design is very intuitive, and the layout seems well thought out.  Our followers seemed to really enjoy browsing through our trip posts and the map overview.  However, there are some things that were a bit frustrating and seem like they could be easily fixed.

First, this app should be built to work on an iPad AND work in landscape mode.  As of now, it does neither. Many competing apps work natively on the iPad, but only work in portrait orientation.  We really wanted to be able to post updates using our iPad with the Smart Keyboard attached while traveling via plane/train/car, but the only way to do this is through the website, which is not always feasible while on the go.  Instead, we were left with making updates on the go on an iPhone, which isn’t great for typing up good notes/posts, or for picking the best photos to attach.

Second, better syncing across devices.  Or more to the point, support for multiple devices using the same account.  My wife and I both wanted to use a joint account and each make updates as needed.  This really wasn’t feasible as updates made on one device sometimes never appeared on another, or even on the website.  Please enable multiple device support, designate one device as the “master” and only use the position data from that device.  Problem solved.

Third, notifications.  There really should be a way for followers to better customize notifications for all sorts of things: updates to a specific trip only, updates to all trips, photos added, comments on posts, etc.  This really seems like an overlooked area of the app.

Lastly, more control over editing step locations.  I would have really loved the ability to simply select or enter a Lat/Long to place a step.  We spent a great deal of time on our trip “off the grid” where there were a lot of erroneous steps placed by the app.  Simply editing the Lat/Long would have been an easy way to fix the errors.

Overall, this is a fantastic app that could use a few updates to really make it outstanding.

author: a cobra catcher

title: Useful, memorable
content: Three trips so far recorded on this app. Can update with new text or photos, keep track of your location, and at the end you have the option to create a beautiful book of your travel. Can't recommend this app highly enough, my extended family and I are all members so we can keep track of each other. Love hearing about trips in everyone's voices. Very motivating to keep track of your travels.
author: helladead

title: Great app to track and share your trip
content: Polarsteps is a great app to share pictures and videos. You can upload even without a phone connection, then it uploads to the system when you connect again. Fast to upload pictures, and takes a little longer for videos but still acceptable. Really enjoying the Polarsteps app!
author: Jeff Niemi

title: Great for nomadic traveling
content: I love this app. I’ve been using it for years. I use it to track and journal all of my travels. But it is particularly good for nomadic-type traveling where we move through many different locations throughout the trip. I love being able to track and see my route, and I love being able to easily produce a photo book at the end!
author: Heb789

title: Great Travel Tracker App
content: Have used Polarsteps for a few years as a travel tracking app. It tracks the places we’ve been to and accurately shows the route. Needs a cruise setting because sometimes it shows us cutting through land. Other than that it is a useful app for sharing pics and showing friends and family where you’ve been.
author: lking9

title: Family loved it
content: My family loved being able to track my trip and follow the adventures as I traveled. I was inspired after seeing my friend’s beautiful album. Can’t wait for my own. I’m going to use Polarsteps every time I travel. It was easy to post and I loved sharing the details of what I was doing, especially knowing that it was an intimate group of the people that I invited.
author: Deep Chris

title: Value of Polarsteps
content:
We have used this app several
Times to share our images and thoughts during recent travels . It’s interactive so those following the trip  can also make comments or ask questions. 
The images and text are high quality and can be used to produce a beautiful journal of one’s trip. We highly recommend this app .
author: flyn brian

title: Let us title photos
content: I like Polarsteps and use it to document all of my trips and keep people at home updated.  However, sometimes it seems to randomly show I flew a section of a tour when it was overland, or just puts a straight line when I was on a winding road. Even more annoyingly it won’t allow the photos to be labelled.  It would maketravel joutnalling so much easier and better if this was possible
author: English Bob 1632

title: Amazing Travel App!!
content: Great app for documenting my travels, sharing the details of our adventures with close family and friends, and making the occasional travel book.  The books are EXTREMELY high quality and super easy to generate (and modify if you want) from the information and photos you upload while traveling.  Can’t recommend the app enough!
author: Horoko12

title: Update
content:
Have used app for over a year and use to track location for our cruises.  The last update has provided inaccurate locations.  

Current trip it shows us by Key West when in fact between Miami and Ft. Lauderdale.  

That is only thing I would request to be looked at and updated.  Previous update was much better for this.
author: Brobinson767

title: Fun and Functional
content: A friend of mine started using this app a number of years ago for her travels. It was really neat the way it works. I used it on a trip to Europe last year. Will use it on all my future trips. One of my best friends. Started a 28 day trip today out west and he is using it. We are all like in our 60s, so you can guess the ease of use is pretty good. Highly recommended.
author: Krnyj

title: Stops tracking randomly, lost trip data
content: They need to have the option to enable a push notification or email if the app doesn’t receive an update after 24 hours or three days. I’ll go days or weeks without checking the app only to find out that the app stopped recording my steps weeks ago and then starts adding a new step once the app opens. Now I can’t create a cool book because a huge block of time is missing and inaccurate now
author: Sthardman

title: Fantastic, just one thing...
content: This app has a fantastic user interface and is perfect for logging and recording your travels, the only thing that I would change is that there is only one method of exporting your trips (besides just downloading the raw data): the print book copy. I would absolutely love if we could have a pdf copy of the book, even if it only came along with the printed copy or something else, but that would be absolutely fantastic and this missing feature is the only problem so far.
author: nickdlevi

title: The best way to memorize your trip
content: After every trip I regret having too many pictures and not remembering everything we did. With Polarsteps, you force yourself to pick out the best pics and keep a short journal daily. It truly memorizes your trip in the best way, and at the end you can decide to have a travel journal printed, with pictures. It’s perfect!!!
author: JantjeMieke

title: Perfect combination. Pics and tracker
content: This app has become one of my favorites and I’ve been able to get friends on it too. The ability to GPS track my journey and add pictures and videos to location is exactly what I wanted. I’d love to see a new feature where it automatically adds pictures to current location.
author: RDBtravels

title: Great way to update family and friends
content: I am on the road for months at a time. Polarsteps provides an easy, visual platform to let people know where I am. It is super easy to add photos and a quick note. I like to prompts to add new places. It really helps me remember where I was on a given date when I have lost track of time. The map is the best feature!
author: Gliderprez

title: Awesome Travel Tracker
content: Polarsteps has allowed me to document my travels in one easy to use application and share my journey, live, with those close to me. Traveling primarily by sea, the offline functionality is great, though GPS coordinate input for location would be a great addition to the mobile app. Overall, I’d recommend the app to anyone looking to document their travel experiences and/or share their adventures with others.
author: Zach_Miller13

title: Always room for improvement
content: Really amazing concept. Am disappointed that your planned steps can’t be more specific than the city. Like we are planning regular weekend trips where we visit one small city for a few days and I want to add that we are going to the museum, then the library etc. but it wont get that specific. My suggestion would be to at least allow notes to be made on each step so that you could notate which place you plan to visit.
author: ekw95

title: Wannabe travel book author.
content: I’m the one gawking at the sights while others are cameras out/capturing memories. No more! Polarsteps is my muse in letting family know what I’m up to and having a memory book when we get home. Never going to be fancier than my more organized friends, but waaaaaay better then my usual: “We came. We saw. We forgot to take pictures. “
author: HelloHowdyBonJour

title: Better 5 years ago than today
content: The app was amazing when it came out, I used it a few times and shared it with many people. Today, I don’t see much change except in the usability. Touch any location and it zooms out to show your entire trip. I will likely move to another travel app after this current trip, it’s too frustrating trying to add information and continuously needing to zoom in  after touching the screen
author: asdf9473737

title: Once great, now frustrating and buggy
content: I used to love this app, but it’s recently become virtually unusable on my iPhone. My changes often are not saved and don’t sync, very short videos simply won’t upload when in the past, longer videos would upload without any issues, and it seems I can only use it on a laptop. I’ve wasted a great deal of time crafting comments for entries only to have it randomly refresh and erase everything I had just written or uploaded. I really hope they address these issues but until they do, I can’t recommend using it.
author: Shedrock

title: Use this!
content: I’ve used this app traveling and just love it!  It follows you without draining the phone battery and creates a great log for your travels.  I love the photo and essay addition you can add as you go or incorporate it later to use as a journal.  It keeps track of the countries you have visited which makes me want to add more to my collection!  Great travel app now go use it!
author: Hinessight

title: I love the results of this app BUT
content: we have done a number of trips using this app.  and love it.  BUT why is it so difficult to have two people be admins????  If I am not the primary admin, when I add a step, or attempt to, the app gets stuck on synchronizing and NEVER finishes.  I have to have my partner add the step first so that I can edit it. But seems like something that should be easy to implement.  Most IT systems allow for backup admins.
author: AlyssaG888

title: Travels Made Complete!
content: Hundreds of pictures on a vacation narrowed down to your favorite, being able to journal what you are feeling and doing, and then click a few choices and you can have a photo album… I have had this app since 2016 and wouldn’t choose any other way to reminisce about my travels.. this app is fabulous!
author: Jane's joyous journeys

title: Concept is good but needs refinement
content:
First, the gps or location finder is way off. I’d like to see the pictures positioned closer to where I take the picture. For example, pics in Maui on the beach are showing up at a nearby golf course .30 miles away. That is just too far off. Apple photos does way better, so I’m not sure the advantage of the app. 

Second, historical trips are just way too hard. It does not seem to read meta data correctly. Pics people send to you are filtered as if you were there at the time. So, you could be in Spain and the US at the same time. Seems like some more thought should be put into how it determines relevant photos. 

Lastly, I can’t seem to edit a comment once I make it. 

Overtime this could be a five star app. They should work with Garmin or someone else for geocaching. Step behind.
author: Warlords of corporate greed

title: Nice travel journal
content: I really enjoyed using Polarsteps to document my amazing trip to India. It automatically keeps track of your travels and creates a entry for each day. You can then write as much or as little as you want along with posting pictures of your day. It’s very easy for other people to follo you on your journey. My only wish is that you could add individual captions to each picture.
author: Me864

title: FINALLY
content:
cons first: the app crashes almost every time i try to upload more than 15 picture at a time. my biggest gripe is that i can’t upload videos!!!! i have so many videos from my travels and i hope an update comes soon to let me update them and this really is the only reason for the 4 star review

but the PROS: this app rocks, the organization, the layout, the interface, it’s exactly what i wished existed for years!!! thank you so much!!!!!!!
author: georgegaston

title: Great for bringing friends/family along on the journey!
content:
Fantastic app all around!  My only complaint is that the stats page is designed for world-travel, with no ability to track more regional trips (ie, number of US states visited)
I have thoroughly enjoyed every bit of my time using this app otherwise.  It’s a great way for friends and family to keep tabs on adventures as they happen
author: SteffeyStudios

title: Six Countries With Polarsteps
content: I’ve never used this app before, but it was recommended by Eurail.  I was quite afraid I wouldn’t know how to work it, but it did work out quite well.  I just tried to remember when I laid down at night to put in my pictures and write a little blog about the day.  I do believe it turned out well.  The next will be to order our book.  It’s a pretty easy learning curve.
author: KKVentura

title: Now and Later
content: I used this app to record and share our big trip to England. My friends and family could easily follow our trip. Once we got home I edited the pictures I uploaded and paid for a photo album. It was beautifully done. I have recommended Polar steps to everyone who tells me they are traveling.
author: NonTechie300

title: Love it!
content: Such a fun easy way to keep track of all your travels. If in the future you want to find a picture from a certain trip, you just click on that stop rather than trying to scroll through your camera roll to the date you think you took the picture. Love this app!
author: Katie J 111286

title: The BEST travel archive!
content: I have recommended Polarsteps to so many friends and family because it is a fantastic travel journal app. It is easy to use, and you control with whom you share your travels. I don’t like sharing trips on social media for the whole world to see. I also love Polarsteps’ mapping function. It’s nice to see where you’ve been.
author: DeniseFBR

title: PlayWanderSee
content: PolarSteps has been a perfect friend and companion during our journey. I have been able to record our experiences with an ease I didn’t know was possible until one of our many new friends showed me this app. It’s also been a unique education as I watch my friends make their way around the world.
author: ddw505

title: Great app, needs better end times
content:
I’ve wanted a good travel tracker for years, and this is the top I’ve found. Easy to see where you’ve been and great to add important stopping points.

Only piece of feedback: I want to put in an end date *and time*. Alternatively, a way to say “end trip”. None such feature exists, so I find myself disabling the location when I want to do this as a workaround.
author: kbrookshier

title: Why do you need to write into my photo?
content:
The app looks great but I am not using it until more details are available.
I can see why you would want to read my photo library, but please explain why do you need to write into my photo library?  Are you modifying my photos or add additional photos to my photo library?
I keep all my original photos in full size in my Apple iCloud, and I do not want any app to write resize, and modify my photos.
author: bi-jc

title: Revolutionize your travel journal
content: I’m super bad about taking pictures and recording what I get up to while on a trip. Polarsteps has completely changed that for me. It’s the best and most fun way to track your adventures and share them with friends and family. No other travel app even comes close, I highly recommend giving Polarsteps a shot on your next trip.
author: Xolisi

title: Great way to remember and visualize trips
content: So amazing for our trips across Europe where we drive across borders and stop in random towns. This makes it easy to remember the key aspects of our trips and everything chronologically. Wish they had an iPad app, but will take what I can get. Highly recommend as an easy to use travel journal.

title: Best app for travel EVER
content: I’ve never found such an amazing app to document our trips like this one. It’s so easy that I’m planning on going back to make books for previous trips. Depending on my experience, I may update my review. However, the process while on my current vacation has been phenomenal. Eager to order my first book!
author: JWalterPillow

title: Great way to share trip with friends
content: This app is a great way to share a trip with family and friends. I hate sharing hundreds of photos at the end of a trip . It’s overwhelming and disorganized. This app solves that problem by allowing me to give updates with just a link to my friends as I’m doing the trip.
author: Gigigooo1

title: Best Travel Documentation App I’ve Ever Seen
content: Go places and track your trips with this AWESOME APP! This is a very user friendly app that makes it easy to upload photos and write a few quick notes about the particular “step” in your trip. This is very well done and great on I-phone and PC alike. I highly recommend this for the avid traveler.
author: Kiesenhofer4

title: Needs Update for Grid Photos in Steps
content:
Updated February 16, 2023:

In the iOS app, if I have a trip and step within that trip, with say 250+ photos, the user needs to manually swipe through all 250 photos to get to the most recently added photos, therefore developing carpel tunnel in their finger. I think this is some low hanging fruit that would make the UI much more enjoyable.

Keep up the good work!
author: scooterscotty69

title: Polarsteps changed my life
content: I started using Polarsteps in 2019, and I am so sorry that I didn’t discover it before. Now all my long trips are recorder there and I love it. I use it as a diary and my husband uses his to print our books. Our kids can follow us and we enjoy traveling around the world with them through it.
author: Reading Women Writers

title: ❤️I Love This App
content: I have been using this app for years to record my trips and special occasions! It’s so easy to use. I don’t look back on my photos in IPhoto or Google Photo, but I frequently look at my Polarsteps albums. I love to see the maps and to read my journal entries. Thanks, Polarsteps, for  a fun way to create and record the stories of my life!
author: Alison’s Adventures

title: Polar Steps without including specific polar region
content:
This is a great Travel tracker, maybe the best!
However, does not honor its name, "Polar Steps"
I was surprised when I was not able to add locations in and around the Antarctic Peninsula.I would like to include locations of my 23 days Epic Antarctic via Falkland Island and South Georgia Island which both islands are included in the App. However, none of these more accessible locations of the Antarctic  Region are not included in the application.
