author: The girl from Paraguay

title: First time user
content: Using this app on my trip through Japan seems to be very helpful. My problem is I keep forgetting to do locations until after I’ve already traveled there which makes me have to go back, publish and edit.  If I become more disciplined, it may be better.  Thanks for the app
author: Odyssey TV

title: Perfection
content: I love PolarSteps. I am on my fourth trip using it. I find it easy to use and easy to edit. I look forward to adding a step each evening and my family members love following me. I have 3 books so far. I really like them and get better with each one. I take the books out often and relive my trips.
author: childebr

title: Memories for Miles
content: This app is my go-to for all my trips. I love the fact that it creates books to have afterwards so I can look back lovingly. It has been here for me when I went hiking in Colorado and started my relationship and it was here for me when I got married in Maine. The app is free and great to share. Meanwhile, the book is worth every penny.
author: SarahAnn B.

title: Return customer
content: I used this app for our first River boat cruise. It is easy to use and we enjoy looking at our book and seeing our trip and where we had gone. You forget after a few years. Very thankful for this app that provides a wonderful service to preserve  memorable events in our lives.
author: Decorinaday

title: Highly Recommend
content: Polar Steps is amazing, especially for Road Trips. It easy to use and lets you add pictures and text to each destination along your journey. Then at the end you have an amazing book of your adventure that they will print for you! I have a luxury RV travel business, Find Your Road, and recommend this app to all of our customers. Love it!
author: Find Your Road

title: Best travel app for recording memories!
content: I've been using this for quite a while now and I thoroughly love how we can add/delete steps while it also tracks location so closely. I wish this app would take off to utilize network effects but at the same time, I love this for personal use for the time being.
author: kevinjjcyoung

title: Best Travel App
content: We absolutely love this travel app. Everyone in our family uses it and it’s a fun way to keep track of their adventure or broadcast your adventure when you were on the road. I can’t wait to get up in the morning and over a cuppa coffee see where my brother is sailing. My sister is hiking. Truly must do.
author: Babs on the road!

title: Tracking our travels is a breeze with Polorsteps
content: I always enjoy traveling yet keeping up on these travels can be a bit challenging.  With Polorsteps, I can revisit my specific trip, exact places, comments and photos.  Additionally, I appreciate the ability to track all travel experiences across the globe.  Highly recommend
author: kdoggydoggydog

title: Lost all my trips
content: I really loved this app because I travel all the time and I’m not good of keeping track. It helped me use my photos to track all of the cool places I’ve been. I’ll admit I haven’t used it in several months but when I logged in it has removed all the “steps” my trips and won’t sync or update anymore, essentially rendering the app useless. I tried several troubleshooting steps from the website and I’d be willing to pay for a full version if that was the problem but that doesn’t even seem to be an option.
author: itslikeadisco

title: Great to follow your friends
content: This was really a fun app to use to follow my friends as they traveled. I got a day by day look with photos and stories by following them. You can see where they are in the world and click on the spot, go back to previous stops and get added info about the area.
author: Sunnysammet

title: Great interface!
content: I love the interface of the app and its convenience. I love that it can track my steps and summarizes my trips in a really beautiful way! I just gave it a 4 though since i’m having trouble switching between devices with the same account. Some stuff don’t appear on the other device if i’ve uploaded or edited it on the other. But besides that, i love the app! I’d recommend everyone to download this!
author: MD2588

title: Amazing app - feel like on journey with them!
content: I’ve been able to follow my dear friend walk across Spain seeing her pictures and posts and  seeing exactly where she is right down to the houses and streets in the villages with the GPS. So easy to use, excellent quality.  I can’t wait to use it to track my next journey!!!!!
author: scam me no more

title: Great App But...
content: It's a great app for logging your adventures and adding your pictures but I think it would be great to have a feature to view a world map that you can zoom in and the cities/towns are highlighted to further show where you have been in addition to the pins marking your exact locations.
author: versacemydraws

title: Great for International
content:
I really like this app. It’s a lot of fun to see statistics about how many countries you’ve been to, miles you’ve traveled, percentage of the world seen, etc. I just have three things that would make this app more enjoyable to me: 

 1) The ability to join trips together into one travel book would be great. 

 2) An additional breakdown for flags within countries like the flags of different states in the US. I use Polar Steps as a road trip tracker and just think it would be cool to stack up state flags as well as country flags. 

3) The ability to zoom in on the world map behind my avatar to see all my trips at a glance.

Other than these three minor things, this app is amazing!
author: Rukian (roo-key-en)

title: Have shared and seen many adventures through Polarsteps
content: I love this app!  I have been using it since 2018. I love that I can share my adventures with friends and family. I have also made friends and family use Polarsteps so I could live vicariously through them!!!  I got to see Africa and never left the house😂
author: Bkdahill

title: Great concept but VERY buggy!
content: This app is a great concept but the amount of bugs is so disappointing. The app is very sluggish while in use. I get constant “synchronization” errors that only go away if I log out but after logging back in I have to re-download literally hundreds of photos. The format for entering time changed in the latest version for some reason and app elements overlap so it looks strange and is just awkward to use now. There’s so much potential here but as of late I feel the app is getting worse with every update!
author: YQVF

title: Full time RV’er Dream
content: I have been looking for an app that I can use to share our travel plans with our family.  This one is great.  It meets our needs and my family loves that we can add pictures.  My only suggestion is that the addresses when I try to add a place, especially a campground, are very difficult to see and many don’t show up.
author: Frustrated Player 213

title: Great app HORRIBLE SHIPPING PURCHASES
content:
I’ve use the app for multiple trips. I bought three photo books now from them; super slooowwww delivery... despite the promises of two weeks delivery the first book took a month to arrive. 

I tried again and it’s been even longer this time. Use the app do not buy the photo book.

I would pay the cost of a book to get a pdf. Why create this amazing digital experience then force me to paper??
author: Donng

title: Great App
content: I love this app for my family vacations. Family can follow along with our adventures and know where we are during our trip. I can write down what we did and funny things that happened. I love looking back at past vacations. Highly recommend this app. Easy to use. It’s one of my favorite apps.
author: nwalker821

title: Private, fun and a great optional photo album
content: I love this app. It makes revisiting my trip and remembering details so much easier plus it is focused so I only see the trips I want to see about people I love. I recommend to everyone. Oh and if you haven’t ordered the photo album… you really should, they are fantastic.
author: Neurogirlamg

title: Great app
content: Polar steps is a fun way to connect with loved ones during travels, and a great way to keep up with friends you meet on the road. i think it also creates a new way to interact / experience your own travel i really like the integration of the map. few minor qualms not coming to mind atm overall love
author: Lekshhhhh

title: Great app
content: We wanted an app that track our journey to Spain and Portugal.  This app allows you to track and pictures as you travel.  Easy to post.  We had a book made of our trip.  It’s a quality coffee table book.  People who see it want too know where we had it done.  Good memories!
author: Coarsegold 1

title: My travel tip
content: I absolutely love this app. My family of 4 is on a quest to visit all 50 states and I wanted somewhere to keep all our memories without being on a social media platform. This is perfect and I can turn the uploads into a book afterwards!  If anyone asks for travel tips this is the first one I give them!
author: Dex 4

title: Best place to post photos of your trips!!
content: My family and I followed my daughter and her friends on PolarSteps as they traveled through Europe after college graduation. The graduates loved posting multiple photos on PolarSteps and journaling about their journey. They also felt more comfortable posting multiple photos on PolarSteps than on Instagram.
author: Hiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!

title: Forever memories
content: First of all thank you for building this app. My girl and I went on a 6 month long rv trip around the USA. And we used this app from the beginning. We have recorded so many memories and plan on getting one of your books. This app is awesome. Best times of my life all put together nicely thanks to you guys.
author: DRKbadger

title: Track your trips
content: This is an amazing app that tracks every place I have been and you can add photos either taken from the app or from your library so anybody can see every place that you have traveled. It’s quite amazing. The only downside to it is sometimes it seems to freeze up when you have a lot of photos on it.
author: tabitrips

title: PolarSteps
content: Love this app. We’ve been on the road for 9 months and have used this as our electronic journal.  Bonus, friends and family can follow along.  It will be in my top 5 of “things” I’d keep if I could only choose 5!  Now, PolarSteps needs to figure out to offer a feature where I can buy a printout of my beautiful trip map that was created in the app!!!  😉
author: Lora-O

title: Keeping track
content: This is the best app I’ve found to keep track of my daughters trips through out the world. She’s a mariner so her work takes her many places. The app notes where the pic was taken on a map & also marks your rout of travel. You can make different folders for different trips.
author: mustangpeet

title: Amazing app
content: Our son and family are on a 2 month Italy vacation with 20+ stops.  Our daughter and family are on a 3 month rv trip in WA OR CA.   We are following each a few times per day.  Peace of mind for us and they provide commentary and tons of pics daily.  We love Polarsteps!!!!  Thank you so much for this appp.   It is wonderful.
author: DeanRep

title: Excellent app
content: I’m very been using polar steps for about three years now. It’s such an easy way to keep track of my travels and share with the family and friends that I want to. It’s as private or public as I choose. Very easy to use and regular updated. Highly recommend.
author: L34nn3k4r3n

title: Capture Memories
content: This is an awesome app to capture your memories and pictures in real time. There’s no limit on the number of photos and you can choose to share your journey or not. Best part, upon returning home, you can have a quality book printed of your entire trip.
author: Sherri the traveler

title: What a fun app!
content: I am following my daughter and her husband on a 500-mile walk across northern Spain on the Camino de Santiago.  She uploads photos and briefings almost every day.  It is such a big adventure, every day brings challenges that enliven the spirit, and through this app I feel privileged to share in it with her. Thank you so much!
author: Jean-too

title: Latest update not so great
content:
Was working pretty good until the most recent major update. It no longer finds the correct address when typed in... No.. I don’t live in Sweden or Indonesia.. And the best I can do is the middle of city I live in. 

If one could just drop a pin to the map that would make this a great app or even move a point for better accuracy. GPS option would be nice. 

This app went from 5 stars to 2 on this update. If it doesn’t improve soon this will just become a waste of my time.
author: jmgj01

title: Favorite travel app
content: We love a good international road trip and this is the best way to map it out, keep our memories and photos organized, and share our adventure with friends and family. We also love how it basically builds or photo book for us at the end.
author: Brinda39

title: Best Travel Memories App
content: I have enjoyed using Polarsteps for the last few years. Great features and always adding more! Love tracking my trips and seeing my path across the globe. I’ve encouraged family and friends to use the app to watch my travels and share their own.
author: bmesanko

title: Video upload error
content: I have been using polarsteps for about 7 weeks now to track my travels. I loved it at first and had no issues, however in the last few weeks I CONSTANTLY have issues uploading videos. I've tried uploading videos on wifi & data, it still comes up with an error though. Not sure I'll continue using it if this bug persits.
author: Mmmmgggffff

title: Didn’t work very well
content: I was excited to use this to track where we went on a trip.  Was very disappointed at the end of the trip to find out that it was very inaccurate - it missed a flight and 2 long drives at the start of the trip and started us in the 3rd city we visited.  Also the granularity for hikes/drives we took was very poor, it looks like it was sampling location very infrequently, so it shows us moving in a straight line over the water between points multiple miles away.
author: j9192

title: Easiest scrapbooking ever
content: Have used this for three different trips. Great for more than just the 3 pix on FB. People who want to know more can follow. Especially nice that other travelers with you can add photos, etc. And then you must order the book from them. It’s really well done!!
author: Joelle71

title: Recommended
content:
Using on all of my personal trips to capture moments and good memories to look back at.

There are few improvements that the app can make - e.g. syncing local attractions with google maps  as lot of them are not available. Smart time zone detection would help as well.
author: SRT200

title: Family adventures with us
content: Our family is able to watch where we go and what we have seen as we travel internationally.  This app is a game changer.  My mom no longer worries about me wondering where I am.  I have given her permission to see where we are in real time and she LOVES it!
author: KristalB

title: Love it ! BUT
content: I have three trips that were taken years ago that still show I am traveling. I have tried numerous times to go in and change the end date. I have deleted the app. I am only working on my iPhone. I can’t understand why I can’t get it to end the trip.
author: PrettyBird52

title: This app is great!
content: Our son is traveling the world so this app keeps us informed and updated. My only complaint is that it’s a bit difficult to set up as a follower. I have some family and friends who would like to follow along but can’t get it to work. Other than that it’s really great. We’re thankful to be able to follow his journey
author: P / Boston

title: Great trip journal
content: I’ve been using this for a few years now and I love logging my trips this way. It’s great during my travels so my friends and family know I’m safe. When I return from my trip, it’s an easy way to share with friends the highlights and key memories.
author: LesbianErkel

title: Loving Polarsteps
content: This is a great app! Once you navigate the site it becomes a great tool to record trips and memories that I would otherwise not remember. My friends and family can follow along to see where I have been and what fun things we did along the way.
author: Looper Nic

title: Travel Diary Made Easy
content: been loving this app. makes keeping my friends and family so easy and fun. I do wish there was a feature where i could turn off the live location without going private or followers only just for safety reasons.
author: arty0129

title: Love it already.
content:
I just found my new favorite travel journal. I am able to create blog like posts of my travels with ease. It makes me want to go on trips even more than I already do! NOTE: The sooner you add support for videos the better.

Update: THERE’S VIDEO SUPPORT NOW and it’s awesome! :D This app has been a perfect tool used to capture my moods, thoughts, and scenery of my travels.
author: Ms. Diamond Lee

title: Share your travels with a select group!
content: Tired of EVERYONE following your trip? PolarSteps lets you share with the people you want to know all the details & lets you make a physical memory book too. Easy upload, easy edit, easy share. And private!
author: Maggietext

title: Fantastic!!!
content: We’ve used this app for years and can’t say enough about how wonderful it is having such a comprehensive view of our trips. The cool interactive globe showing our travels and the ability to trace the actual locations of all our adventures is priceless
author: Megan Lovestotravel

title: Fantastic way to log your travel
content: We love capturing our travel with Polar Steps. The interface is very intuitive and works very well. It makes looking back at your memories so much more enjoyable. Additionally your family and friends can follow along in real time. Love it!
author: bombaszka68

title: Love Polarsteps!
content: I used Polarsteps for the first time on a six week trip around New Zealand. It is fun and easy to use.  Your friends can follow and post and enjoy the images from each area. So they learn about the areas you are traveling in as you move around. Thank you for a great app 😄
author: Carol HI

title: Trips
content:
What an amazing app to document trips and have friends and family know where you are step by step and read your journal entries . 
I love Polarsteps 
My wish would be that one huge book could be made with no limit on pages . Hint hint
author: Loveroflife 12

title: Great app, but takes time for books to arrive
content: This app is fantastic. Easy to use and translates into wonderful designs. I ordered two books and one showed up within two weeks, the other took two months. It took a lot of back and forth with support to finally get the book. I’m based in the USA so that might be the issue (maybe best to limit use of this to Europe).
author: Bob-a-job-a-jobbie

title: A digital “carnet de bord”
content:
When captains were tracing their explorations on their “carnet de bord”, they became treasures shared. Polarsteps is that digital version allowing to be near real time adventure sharing with family & friends, marking your geolocation as a tracer showing the way and bringing peace of mind that you’ll never be lost 😉 —should any unplanned step occurred. 
Cheers,
Jérôme
author: Sinnamary

title: Great travel app
content: Love this easy to use app.  My husband and I retired and started traveling and wanted to track our trips and share with family and friends this is so easily to use and nice to share with.  Such a great app will recommend to everyone we know
author: Heather & Rick

title: Wonderful travel log
content: My daughter is backpacking through Southeast Asia with one of her friends. Her friend started a Polarsteps and it’s been wonderful to see her pictures, many of which have my daughter in them, as well as reading the commentary ❤️❤️❤️. Highly recommend.
author: LibbyinPa

title: AMAZING APP!!!
content: This is a great app to see what other people are doing on a trip and/or document your own adventures! I would highly recommend! My brother is currently traveling the world and it is an incredible way to get a sneak peek into what he is doing. It also has translation capabilities!!
author: Sofadoo99

title: Best App to share trips with friends
content: I have been using Polarsteps since its Beta phase and I love it. I like that my trip posts can be private or public. The app is easy to use. The book editing can be a little time consuming but the final product is of first rate quality.
author: Traveling2Learn

title: Issues with UX
content: I love the app but the UX is kinda not good for example I can’t search for a specific location in the guide section  i have to go back and forth google maps to see where it is located on the map , also in the search bar it says search people & place when it shows up it turns to trip , this is UX disaster. Overall make locations searchable
author: Dripsign

title: Suggestion
content:
I’m an early adopter and still love this app. 
It would be nice, though, if the app would automatically import media to the right location.  

At times I am struggling to remember in which small town a pic was taken - then I spend lots of time matching up times and locations. 

IOS has already made available to the app where and when something happens - just put  all the media with the right location point. 

It’s easier to delete media you don’t want to post than to find it after the fact. 

Thanks.
author: Slightly dissappointed

title: Love this app
content: PolarSteps makes it so easy to share my pictures with family and friends while I am traveling. I absolutely love that, after my adventure is done, I can use the app to create the most gorgeous book to save and enjoy for years to come.
author: 301279642783Kat

title: Brilliant so far!
content: What a great concept, and an incredible way to document your travels. I plan on doing a big adventure trip in every continent and Polar Steps will be with every step of the way :) I have yet to order my first book but have heard from others that they are amazing quality. The prices are very good.
author: wcjf03

title: Love it!
content: Love so much about this app: the map, being able upload pics and videos of where you are every day, people can follow you as you go, and finally you can print a book when you’re done!
author: Paulamz67

title: Travel Tracker
content: I love this app!  I live in the US and my brother is sailing around the world and with this app I can follow along. My sister in law posts pictures en route daily which allows me the opportunity to get a glimpse of what they are seeing in their daily travels.  I highly recommend PolarSteps.
author: Sheister68

title: Needs improvement
content: I got this app to make a trip map to share before actually going on the trip. It did not let me do that. You have to actually go on the trip first before it creates your reel. Another problem is that it only offers a car or a plane as the little traveling picture. I am going by train and boats to some destinations and the app does  not have an icon/picture of a train or a boat.
author: solock117

title: Love this app
content: A friend told me about Polarsteps and I immediately downloaded it.  I love how it shows you on a map where you’ve been and lets you download your videos and photos.  It’s awesome for my family and friends to keep track of our adventures.
author: Okies gsp

title: Just what we were looking for
content: We are on a 3 month road-trip across the US and our family and friends wanted a way to “follow us”. We wanted a way to help us remember every single stop. We tried out a few different apps—Polar Steps is perfect!
author: Literarylass

title: Good start
content: Excellent app. But really it should slow the user to automatically take the pictures taken on the camera during the journey and place them on the polarstep app. To do it afterward awkward. Great start. Improve. Or sell to Apple. Would be great if integrated in photo
author: evrardbordier

title: How social goes on vacation
content:
An amazing way for family and friends to follow you on a trip. We used it while traveling in Thailand on a church trip with teens. The families were able to follow each step of the way with photos at each location. 
After that experience we started using it for personal travel, grandmas love the pics of the kids in cool places. 
Let’s us record work trips my spouse can follow.

Cons:
Automatic tracking is annoying. Adds points in incorrect locations and way to many of them. Turn this off and add your own manually.
Also the app is a bit slow getting gps, off line post could be better.
author: Lidsmom

title: Great idea but one big bug
content: The whole point is to be able to create your own trips when the app doesn’t automatically sync it right?. But when I go to edit the date of the step, it automatically reverts to some random date, so it throws off all of the steps. Why would it block me from entering a custom date?
author: T2024

title: Best travel app
content: Got this independent app at the advice of my sister, and I’ve never looked back. It tracks when you’re off-line, is easy to navigate and edit! Love it! Best of all, your info and photos are secure and will not be sent to some commercial enterprise!
author: travelerjohn

title: Awesome app!
content: So easy to use and a great way to keep track of our son and girlfriend’s adventures. Love that we get notifications whenever they post new pictures and videos and journal entries. The map of where they’ve been and where they are is cool too!
author: Vermitts

title: Freedom Van
content:
Great app, easy to use. We purchased the book, it looks very good and arrived quickly.
The app has minimal editing options, however the simpler approach keeps the time spent more focused on the adventures instead of  time fussing with the picky details of the formatting, etc.
author: mailman603

title: Polar steps
content: This is the one of my most favorite apps, it is easer to use and fun to share with friends and family. It dose bog down a little the more you add for example I have a 3 month long Europe trip and it hold the picture data so my use is a little slow and I still give it 5 stars.
author: Guidobunnsnu!

title: Awesome app
content: I travel a fair amount and have found this app to be AWESOME. in the early days of using the app it had a couple small issues but the support team is incredible about addressing everything.  Also goes back in time to help load previous trip prior to having the app.
author: T. Johnson

title: Easily Track & Document Trips!
content:
Growing up I would keep a journal for each family vacation. Polarsteps, for me, is the modern adaptation of the journals I used to write as a child. 
So often you have an assortment of random pictures from trips that you struggle to remember the context of each. Overall great app!
author: Justcallmedarci

title: Very convenient app with an intuitive layout.
content:
Very easy to use with text, photos and videos. 
Good tracking and automatic suggestions. 
Takes a little extra phone battery but nothing too bad
author: ManojGMenon

title: Awesome App
content: This app allows you to post pictures from your journey as you go.  It shows anyone you share the link with where you are in the world along with the pictures you post from that place. 😁
author: RAV1156

title: Engaging travel tool
content: Having reviewed several options recommended by AI, we chose to test Polarsteps for a Europe trip.  Not only were we impressed by this tool for travel, their photo books are easy to create & of good quality reproductions.
author: Globalpaddler

title: My Fifth trip using Polarsteps
content: I have used Polarsteps for several trips now. I love how easy it is to use and the map of my of my journey. If find it is best to upload photos daily and edit my book on computer when I get home.
author: Water girl 63

title: Vividly vicarious
content:
What a contrast to Instagram!!  This is so informative and almost realtime. If the traveler engages with photos and narrative it is the best there is. 
 Greatly appreciate!
I have several friends traveling that I have suggested use this App. They have not so far.
 Why?  Is it a failure to explain the App? Instagram is silly.
author: A Nilnoc

title: Helpful, joyful, to relive this!
content: Now that I can no longer actually walk these paths, climb these hills, smell these early mornings, it’s wonderful to have Joan and Tye do it in my place. They can help me re-live times that are specially vivid now. Images add themselves to my own, and actually re-enliven memory. Delightful.
author: Fifi lleub

title: Way to go!
content: This app is everything need to document my journey on the Camino. We have recommended it to several other pilgrims & are now following each others’ journeys. We especially like the coordination between map, photos & text. Thank goodness you developed this app.
author: oregonpilgrim

title: What a great way to track travels
content: Perfect way to keep a photographic diary of your travels. Also to keep family up to date, without letting the whole Facebook world know that you are not home. Also love the maps
author: mrs wolt

title: Keeping in Tiuch
content: My daughter has been traveling in New Zealand for a few months. Pilar Steps has been an incredible way to stay connected and really get a idea of where she’s traveling and what she’s experiencing. Super app! Highly recommend it.
author: Susi the traveler

title: Keep up with friends and family
content: This is a great way to keep students, friends, and family updated of one’s travel adventures efficiently.  I only wish the updates could be done retroactively.
author: Global Gourmet Teacher

title: Only 1 complaint
content: I wish I could just go to the current day to add photos and comments. I am now 45 days into my trip and it is becoming a hassle to start at the beginning each day and scroll to the current day. I have a year long trip planned and this is becoming a time burden.  Other than that, I like the app.
author: _swamp_dawg_

title: Awesome “public” alternative to FB & Co
content: If you are tired to post to the “world” on Fb, where it’s missing path and track detail, this nifty app is awesome! You decide who watches it - not Zuckerberg- but who you invite, and it has awesome details (track , location tracking). I love this app!!!
author: xTexLutz

title: Love Polarsteps
content: This is an amazing ap to document your travels. You can edit your info and they print an amazing book for you! This is my second book with hopefully many more to come! The quality is top notch! Just remember to start your journey before you leave home!
author: kitty's adventures

title: Favorite travel app
content: I’ve been using Polarsteps for years now and it’s one of my favorite travel apps. I love that it is like a personal blog and all my friends and family can follow along on my trip and see what I’ve been up to.
author: Tormay5

title: Not well organized
content:
Great idea but I expected it to be more clean app. First, it asked me to share location ALL THE TIME to start with... It's just so much going on in the app that I had hard time to be oriented and find my actual trips in neat and clean way. 
But maybe I had different expectations. I was looking for a app with map to count countries I visited, show them on map and under map have some list of them?
author: Locatotable

title: Location based places
content: Missing one thing, location based places. Would help in selecting place options than typing. That would help in saving time as I like to use this quickly on the go and come back later to edit. Would cut down on the time typing in place names and focus on the sights.
author: ximelord

title: Best travel trip tracker
content: This app is awesome, it allows me to track my travel journeys easily, it organizes my photos to the locations I’ve been and I get to share that with whom I choose and what photos.  I love the travel summary of trips, distance, countries and more
author: WLSWaynes

title: Fantastic Travel Blog
content: I’ve been using this for years. It’s well made, smooth, and free. I’ve gone all over the world with it and made personal travel blogs that have been amazing to share with friends and family.
author: kaitlu

title: Very good
content: I really like this app. It does everything you need for a travel diary…..almost.  I would like to add comments to individual pictures. Instead it adds them to all pictures in each group. If there’s a way, please let me know. That would be my only complaint.
author: Kls081757

title: World traveler
content: This is a wonderful app because it allows us as travelers to keep our family and friends abreast of our travels. It’s almost like they’re being there with us I would highly recommend it.
author: littlebearwheeler

title: Amazing trip tracker
content: A great way to share a trip with close family and friends without publicly telegraphing you’re on vacation for would be thieves. And a photo book at the end is a a great bonus too.
author: iFrosteee

title: Camino Peregrinos
content: We will be starting our 4th and 5th Caminos this week (2026)and Polarsteps will be with us the entire way.  Our PS travel book will be a culmination of all 5 caminos.  What a great app to capture and share our journeys with friends and family.
author: Surfdawg2024

title: Great APP for Traveling
content: Easy to use, pictures are save by location and you can share with your circle of family and friends. They can also follow you on your trips. Great way to make memories.
author: Fitness Vitality Music

title: User Friendly
content: I began using PolarSteps to document walking the Camino de Santiago.   It has worked very well for the most part.  In a few of the smaller villages in Spain the location provided was not accurate, too small to register on GPS I suppose.
author: From Cookeville

title: It sure what this app is about
content:
Looked like a nice app, you can add your hotels in each place in your trip, but you can’t add any planes other than notes, also, travel between cites is only car or plane, why not train option?!!  I was hoping to find suggestions in each town, but nothing, I
Lost Likely will delete.
author: scaryjoe

title: Amazing App
content: I love this app! It’s a great scrapbook to capture and preserve my travel memories. I love that I can upload all of my photos and then delete them from my camera roll. Also, it’s so easy to relive my favorite trips no matter where I am.
author: AngieAskelsen

title: Overheating iPhone 15 Pro 26.1
content:
Wish this app didn't cause my phone to overheat. It was amazing in the short time I used it.

UPDATE EDIT: The developers addressed this issue within a few days and now it seems to be working! Phenomenal work!
author: UncleReyRey

title: States as well as countries
content: I would love if this app also had a how many states have you been to section. The same as the country section but for states!! I would live to know this information.
author: Baglion rawr

title: Great, with one exception
content: Love the app and it’s a great way for friends and family to see where you are while traveling. However, sometimes it’s wildly wrong and says I went to places I didn’t go to, which is very weird. One example, it shows that I went across the Sea of Cortez from Baja to mainland Mexico, but I did not. Other that that it’s good.
author: Watersmeet2020

title: Great app
content: Used this app on our last trip.  We had a book done at the end of the trip.   So easy and looks professional.   Captured our trip and everyone enjoyed keeping up with the trip on social media and really liked the book.
author: rayray3333

title: Great app to track you journey
content: A friend who traveled to Europe recommended Polarsteps to me. It is easy to navigate, and organized your trips and photos. It also makes connecting with other fellow travelers a easy. Highly recommended.
author: Superxela25

title: Around the globe
content: Perfect app for sharing our travel adventures. Easy to post photos, short videos and stories.  Great way for people to see our path visually and know where we are on our adventure.
author: Keane13

title: Share a Trip
content: Polarsteps is a great way to share your trip with friends and family as well as follow others. No need to send pictures via email or text, they can all be there in Polarsteps.
author: RMNPhiker

title: Absolutely love this app!
content: I’ve been using it for four years now. I never travel without it. It tracks in real time where you are and offers suggestions of places to add to your map.
author: Rosemary Ferreri

title: Has it all
content: Our daughter is traveling alone in SE Asia and this has been such a wonderful way for her to regularly update all close family and friends with photos, commentary, and maps all in one spot.
author: Mar-hen

title: Vicarious travel
content: This app allows me to travel with my family to places I cannot go because of physical limitations on my part. I enjoy the beauty, culture and joy of seeing all the posting.  I get to go along from home.
author: Dulcimarg

title: Great app for travel diary!
content:
This app allows me to create an incredible travel diary and offers the chance to print accompanying travel book. 

I can combine text entries, photos/videos,  map locations and web links to sights to provide wonderful context to stops on a trip. 

It also provides useful trip guides to a broad range of geographical areas. 

Wonderful way to share with family and close friends with more depth than on social media without requiring them to install an app.
author: AussiePDC

title: Fabulous app for those of us who can’t travel anymore!
content: Perfect way to join friends and family on wonderful adventures when you can’t be with them in person.
author: Blissisberg

title: Awesome to track travel
content: Been using this for quite a few years and love it. It makes tracking your travel and sharing updates super easy.
author: Dreadlezz

title: Love Polarsteps!
content: Such a fun app for planning and sharing adventures! I love seeing what other people are up to which helps me plan even more fun trips. I haven’t truly used it to its full extent yet with all the travel guides but excited to dive in more! Keep exploring 🧭✌️
author: sophiamelena

title: Traveling with my family through Europe from the USA
content: The application give me the feeling to travel from my house in the USA with my family in Europe.  I can follow them through the countries and beautiful photos they take. Thank you
author: Beaucouptravail

title: One of my favorite apps
content: We love the PolarSteps app as a way to share our travel with friends and family as well as follow travel of our friends.  It is also a nice travel journal for us to look back on.
author: TEliz*

title: Great way to share my tri
content: It’s very easy to use.  I share the link to selected family and friends.  They can check on me at their convenience.  Several family members started to use Polarstep
author: MarathonRS

title: Nice app but some improvements could be done
content: Quite a nice app. A great improvement would be to be able to change your home city in a trip parameters: people move around quite a lot now! And/or to be able to select different home cities associated with a time period.
author: thierrytunes

title: Love seeing our trip on the map
content: We’ve been traveling in our rv  since last October and it has been a great way to keep in touch with family and friends!
author: Kellymousetrap

title: Life share with Polarsteps!
content: I was first introduced to Polarsteps by to actual Dutch men who were in Holland Michigan on business!  I have since used it for all my travels and my extended family and friends enjoy following me online there.   Great App!!!
author: Thisispoor

title: Great app
content: I really like this app. I like being able to track where I’ve been and to add past trips. The only change I would make is to add multiple home locations. I’ve moved around a lot and several of the trips I want to add started from a city different from the one I currently live in.
author: afterglow23

title: Trip saver
content: Love the app. Let’s the family we sent it to track us on our adventures! Love the graphics and the option to purchase a book at the end.
author: The traveling tribe ￼

title: Travel Buddy
content: This app is so fun to use, especially if you have older family members that don’t use social media you can download this app for them and set it up and they can follow your journey
author: Chedda&K

title: Love this App
content: An easy way to keep everyone informed and share the trip in one single app.  It was a bit difficult to figure out at first but once I got the hang of it, use was a breeze.
author: Banaz56

title: Sharing is Caring
content: A Momma’s ❤️heart appreciates all the sharing! Without PolarSteps this momma’s mind would worry way too much, instead I was able to share with my child and grandchild in the excitement of discovering new places! Thank you PolarSteps!!!
author: Dicksonsunny

title: Best Travel Journal App
content: I am a lifelong traveler, and have always handwritten travel journals along the way. This app has replaced all my writings. It is fantastic. It tracks exactly where I visit, and provides an amazing platform for uploading photos
author: Julie Richardson

title: Love!
content: I have used this app for a number of trips and love it! I recommend to all my friends traveling. We have also ordered the travel books the app created. It makes for a great coffee table book!
author: EMRG065

title: Exactly what I needed and more
content: I have no social media but I’m taking life on the road. Loved ones ask me “how can we keep track of you and see pics?” Welll now they finally can!!! Thank you a million times !
author: Yaisah

title: So fun to track trips!!
content: I love being able to track exactly where I’ve been and have the pictures of each specific location. It’s so fun and interactive
author: CammieJean98

title: Enjoy making pictures??!!!
content: Then this is the site. You make them, upload them and write what you want to remember. No more work once you are back home!!!
author: Zrski

title: Best price on photo books!
content: I have never been good at keeping my photos safe and organized. Now I print out my polar steps books regularly because it’s easy and the price point is the best I’ve been able to find.
author: Sggfhkjc

title: Fun to journal and share at the same time
content: A few minutes, a few photos and you have a record of your trip.
author: Best family entertainment

title: Family loves the app
content: My wife and I used it on 6 week Asia trip. Friends/Family loved keeping in touch by seeing all of our updates. The book at the end is the best!
author: RayManJMan

title: World Historian
content: This APP allows one to see parts of the world you may not get to yourself. Friends and family can post from locations that aren’t always in guide books.
author: Flipperup

title: Is there a version for IPad?
content: Great app.  To show pictures to friends it would be even better if the app would display on the whole ipad screen, not just iphone size.
author: foolsgarden@GOT

title: Buggy and Hard to Use
content: Great idea in theory, but the app is so buggy and hard to use. It would take me three days of staring at my phone and dealing with a confusing UI just to get my basic trips uploaded. Out of over 1000 travelers I know, only about 10 of them use this app, and I can't find any other people I know on it, so it's just not worth the effort for me.
author: Dzsóvián

title: Polarsteps !!!!
content: The best app when you want to stay connected on your next adventure or journey. Let’s you share thoughts, pics, videos and makes use easy for the sender and recipient!!! Get it! Use it!
author: LT that’s me

title: A nice program with one issue!
content: A nice program with one issue. When you complete an entry the program takes you back to the first entry and you have to scroll down to where you were to make another entry! Not good...especially if you’re on a long trip
author: Sananda's Place

title: Tracking my cruise
content: This app is super easy to use and gives me a focus to post photos and write about my experiences to share securely with a select group of friends and family. Love it!!
author: Azamara fan

title: Drains Battery
content: App works well. The ‘track me’ feature is very cool, but it absolutely drains your battery. I used it for one week and then checked the battery report on my iPhone 15 Plus. Polar Steps had used 50% of all the battery usage during that period. Can they fix this issue?
author: Indy_5000

title: Makes sharing adventures easy
content: I’m sharing with people I know and acquaintances using this app. It’s easy and fun. Just don’t use unlimited location accuracy if you want your battery to last for your whole adventure.
author: andrienisima

title: Love it!
content: I love using Polar Steps! It’s the best way for family and friends to follow your journeys! I also love following my friends, too. It’s easy to use and post photos. The map makes it really visual for people to watch.
author: JLT36951

title: Great way to explore
content: Polarsteps helps me follow along with friends but that’s not all. With the explore option you can preview what others share about places you may want to travel.
author: Mrsamy
